Describe the resulting behavior for a reviewer who has not seen the conversation. Use an English Conventional Commit title.

## Problem and behavior

Explain the concrete trigger, previous behavior and resulting behavior. Keep the scope bounded.

## Specification and compatibility

Link the SDD and implementation journal. State any changes to project scope, authority, immutable history, receipts or public contracts.

## Validation

List the meaningful RED/GREEN evidence and commands actually run, with results. Include relevant browser or clean-install checks and material limits. CI checks `checks` and `browser` must pass before release acceptance.

## Release impact

State version or migration implications when relevant. Feature and maintenance PRs target `dev`; release and hotfix PRs target `main`. Preserve user data and existing client configurations.
